questions.stem: A 42-year-old patient presents to the emergency department after suspected ingestion of an unknown antifreeze liquid. Laboratory results show: Na+ 140 mEq/L, K+ 4.5 mEq/L, Cl- 100 mEq/L, HCO3- 10 mEq/L, Glucose 90 mg/dL, BUN 14 mg/dL, Ethanol 0 mg/dL, and measured serum osmolality 340 mOsm/kg H2O. What is the calculated serum osmolality and the serum osmolal gap for this patient?

options.text: Calculated osmolality 290 mOsm/kg; Osmolal gap 50 mOsm/kg
Calculated osmolality 285 mOsm/kg; Osmolal gap 55 mOsm/kg
Calculated osmolality 300 mOsm/kg; Osmolal gap 40 mOsm/kg
Calculated osmolality 270 mOsm/kg; Osmolal gap 70 mOsm/kg

questions.sourceExplanation: Calculated Serum Osmolality 計算公式為 2 * Na + Glucose / 18 + BUN / 2.8。帶入數據：2 * 140 + 90 / 18 + 14 / 2.8 = 280 + 5 + 5 = 290 mOsm/kg H2O。Measured Serum Osmolality 為 340 mOsm/kg H2O，因此 Serum Osmolal Gap = 340 - 290 = 50 mOsm/kg H2O。正常的 Osmolal Gap 通常 <= 10 mOsm/kg H2O，顯著升高的 Osmolal Gap 強烈提示血中存在大量未被常規生化測量的 low-molecular-weight osmotically active substances (如 Ethylene Glycol 或 Methanol)。

questions.stem: Which of the following metabolic pathways and enzyme-inhibitory mechanisms best explains the severe systemic toxicity and metabolic acidosis associated with Methanol ingestion?

options.text: Methanol is converted to Glycolic acid by Alcohol dehydrogenase, inhibiting NA+/K+-ATPase
Methanol is converted to Formaldehyde and then Formic acid, which inhibits mitochondrial Cytochrome c Oxidase
Methanol is converted to Oxalic acid, causing direct competitive inhibition of Pyruvate Dehydrogenase
Methanol is converted directly to Acetone, causing severe L-Lactic acidosis

questions.sourceExplanation: Methanol 在體內首先經由 Alcohol Dehydrogenase (ADH) 代謝為 Formaldehyde，隨後迅速經由 ALDH 轉化為 Formic Acid。Formic Acid 會強烈抑制 mitochondrial respiratory chain 中的 Cytochrome c Oxidase (Complex IV)，阻斷 ATP 合成並引發 cellular hypoxia 與重度 High Anion Gap Metabolic Acidosis (HAGMA)。

questions.stem: A 55-year-old chronic alcohol user ingests rubbing alcohol. Laboratory testing shows a marked serum Osmolal Gap of 45 mOsm/kg and positive serum/urine acetone, but serum HCO3- is 24 mEq/L and Anion Gap is 9 mEq/L. Which statement correctly explains this clinical laboratory finding?

options.text: Methanol was ingested, but Formic acid has not yet been produced
Ethylene glycol was ingested, but renal clearance of glycolic acid is super-normal
Propylene glycol was ingested, triggering compensatory metabolic alkalosis
Isopropanol was ingested; its metabolite Acetone causes ketosis and an osmolal gap without releasing protons or causing HAGMA

questions.stem: Compared to Ethanol, what is the major pharmacological advantage of Fomepizole (4-methylpyrazole) in treating Methanol or Ethylene Glycol intoxication?

questions.stem: What is the recommended maintenance dosing escalation protocol for Fomepizole after the initial loading dose of 15 mg/kg IV and 4 maintenance doses of 10 mg/kg q12h?

options.text: Decrease to 5 mg/kg q24h due to drug accumulation in renal failure
Discontinue Fomepizole immediately as ADH receptors are permanently inactivated
Maintain 10 mg/kg q12h indefinitely until toxic alcohol levels drop below 10 mg/dL
Increase to 15 mg/kg q12h because Fomepizole induces its own hepatic P450 metabolism

questions.sourceExplanation: Fomepizole 標準 dosing protocol：Loading dose 15 mg/kg IV，隨後前 4 次給予 10 mg/kg q12h。48 hours 後 (第 5 次 dose 起)，由於 Fomepizole 會 auto-induce 自身在 liver 的 Cytochrome P450 metabolism，因此 maintenance dose 必須調高至 15 mg/kg q12h，直到 serum toxic alcohol level 降至安全範圍 (< 20 mg/dL)。

questions.stem: A patient with severe Methanol poisoning undergoes Intermittent Hemodialysis (IHD). How should the Fomepizole dosing regimen be modified during IHD to ensure therapeutic efficacy?

options.text: Administer Fomepizole every 4 hours or as a continuous infusion of 1.0–1.5 mg/kg/h because Fomepizole is readily dialyzed
Withhold Fomepizole entirely during IHD to prevent severe hepatotoxicity
Double the dose to 30 mg/kg q12h only after IHD is completed
Switch to oral ethanol because Fomepizole is non-dialyzable

questions.sourceExplanation: Fomepizole molecular weight 小且 protein binding 低，在進行 Intermittent Hemodialysis (IHD) 時會被 dialyzer 高效 clearance！為了維持血中足夠的 ADH inhibition concentration，IHD 期間 Fomepizole 的 dosing frequency 必須調高至每 4 hours q4h 或改為 continuous infusion 1.0-1.5 mg/kg/h。

questions.stem: Which combination of toxicokinetic properties renders Intermittent Hemodialysis (IHD) far superior to Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy (CRRT) for rapid clearance of Methanol and Ethylene Glycol?

options.text: High lipophilicity, large volume of distribution (> 3 L/kg), and high protein binding (> 90%)
High molecular weight (> 20,000 Da), rapid hepatic metabolism, and zero renal clearance
Extensive tissue binding, low water solubility, and active biliary excretion
Low molecular weight (< 100 Da), zero protein binding, small volume of distribution (< 0.6 L/kg), and high water solubility

questions.sourceExplanation: 理想的 dialytic clearance toxicokinetic properties 包含：low molecular weight (MW < 100 Da), zero protein binding (0%), small volume of distribution (Vd < 0.6 L/kg) 以及 high water solubility。Methanol (32 Da) 與 Ethylene Glycol (62 Da) 完全符合這些條件，因此 **Intermittent Hemodialysis (IHD)** 的 diffusive clearance 遠高於 CRRT，為首選 dialytic clearance mode。
